title: Crisis-stall FAIL fires when the crisis window never overlaps a dot tick
detail: With base interval 2400 (data/balance.json), a crisis triggered and resolved between two dot ticks (or within one tick: saw_crisis_active is set only after the event loop, and len(s.crisis.active) reads end-of-tick state) yields zero during-crisis dots — the gate false-FAILs a healthy floor.
recommended_fix: Gate the FAIL on the crisis window actually spanning a due dot tick (e.g. track first/last active tick and require an integer multiple of dot_interval inside it), or fall back to the interval-in-[floor,base] proof when no dot tick fell inside the window.

title: Crisis-stall scenario comment still states the old after-crisis semantics
detail: The N1 rework changed the gate to dots DURING the active crisis, but the scenario's doc comment above it still promises 'dots landing after the crisis' — the comment now describes a check that no longer exists.
recommended_fix: Update the crisis-stall comment block to 'a dot lands while the crisis is active (the floor speaks under crisis)'.
